_note: Where an item comes from, for items no sheet covers. Nothing here is guessed: every line was answered by somebody in the Discord and is credited to them, or was stated by TwilightsCall, who runs the server. The game has no working @whodrops, and #item-finder is where players ask instead, so this is the closest thing to a drop table that exists outside the server itself.
_how: build_database.py writes `from` into the item's drop field, but only when the item has no drop of its own, so a sheet or the relic transcription always wins. Items still unanswered are listed under _wanted, which is what to ask Twilight for.
_source: #item-finder and #general in the Discord export, read 17 Aug 2026.

_rules: Souls drop from bosses only. Two of them are unique to Labyrinth Forest, and anything a boss drops can also be crafted at an Archaeologist, except in the secret dungeons. Said by TwilightsCall.
A Nightmare dungeon champion or mini boss only drops its card on the third floor. The ones on the first two floors do not use their real drop table. Said by Shiiiiikiyo and Sylius.
Nightmare dungeons are where shadow gear and the materials for it come from. Said by Sfyn.
Abyss weapons come from Nightmare Abyss and the Nightmare dungeons of the same tier, mostly out of weapon boxes.
The relic exchange NPC tells you which relic drops on which floor, and every dungeon Archaeologist can show the map for the relic you are missing.
The novice set pieces come from the Archaeologists in the low level areas. Said by Brandonowitz.
